verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS cap-table platform like Eqvista, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license or public code. The llms.txt probe and the docs describe only a hosted, proprietary-seeming platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
